messages:
sam: Quick heads-up — planning a quiet rollout of the new GPU pool ramp + autoscale policy tonight 22:00-23:00 PT. A few notes below, pls ack if you own any step.

sam: Who's on deploy? @tess can you lead the rollout ops? @raj will monitor KPIs and trigger rollback if needed.

tess: I can take lead for rollout and smoke. ETA to start 22:00 PT. I’ll run the canary slice first (slice-id: small-3).

raj: I'll be on-call for latency + OOMs. Will watch 95/99 P50/P90 and KV cache hit rate. If P99 > 550ms for >3 mins or OOMs spike, I’ll call rollback.

leo: I did the config PR: https://git.redwood/cfg/ops/merge/4321 — contains new autoscale policy:
```
policy:
  min_replicas: 2
  target_util_pct: 62
  scale_up_step: 1
  scale_down_cooldown: 90s
  burst_window: 30s
```
Apply is `rdeploy apply -e prod --pool gpu-dedicated-ramp`

ana: small nit — target_util_pct tuned from 70->62 after perf run. Verified with local perf harness at seq_len 512. No perf regression on small-3.

sam: Smoke checklist (quick):
- canary slice up -> 1/5 traffic (tess)
- run smoke queries (leo)
- monitor: latency, errors, token throttle, eviction rate (raj)
- validate cost metric (ana)
- rollback button ready (tess)

leo: Smoke queries I’ll run: 20 gen requests varying seq 64/256/512, and a batch embedding job (10k items) to check throughput. Command: `./tools/smoke/run.sh --slice small-3 --cases basic,embed`

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window for 2026-03-17T22:00:00-07:00 -> 2026-03-17T23:00:00-07:00. CI status green. Lockdown: false.

ana: ROI check — note that the new policy reduces spikes but may increase baseline GPU usage by ~6%. Confirmed by sim. Will monitor `cost/unit_token` tag on console.

tess: Starting canary at 22:00. Will post results here. If smoke passes, will ramp 3->7 slices over 20m increments. Manual pause between steps.

raj: Alerts set up:
- cpu/gpu_util > 92% sustained 3m -> pager
- P99 latency > 550ms 3m -> slack alert
- evictions rate > 0.3% 5m -> paging
Slack channel targets: eng-runtime and eng-sre.

leo: One more: KV cache TTL change included (ttl: 10m -> 6m) to reduce memory pressure. Expect slightly higher token compute but fewer OOMs.

sam: Rollback plan:
1) pause ramp and route new traffic back to previous pool variant (`gpu-dedicated-v2`) via `routerctl set-route --policy=legacy`
2) scale down any new slices to 0 with `rscale --pool gpu-dedicated-ramp --replicas 0`
3) file incident ticket and link perf graphs
Estimated recovery time 6-12m depending on routing cache.

tess: Acks: I’ll run steps and keep manual runbook open. @raj pls keep eyes, @leo keep smoke script ready to re-run.

raj: ACK. I’ll be reachable on phone and slack. If I call rollback, I’ll post a short reason and run the rollback commands (I have perms).

leo: ACK. Will post smoke logs here.

ana: ACK on monitoring cost and perf.

sam: Thanks — final note: if anything looks flaky but not critical, prefer to pause ramp and iterate rather than full rollback. Triage guidance: pause -> investigate 10m -> decide.

deploy-bot: Canary started for slice small-3 at 2026-03-17T22:01:12-07:00 (traffic 1%).

tess: Canary smoke: 20/20 gens ok, avg P95 210ms, P99 340ms, no evictions. Embedding batch throughput nominal. Posting raw logs: `s3://redwood-smoke/2319876543/canary/*.log`

raj: Looking at telemetry: P99 340ms, GPU util 44%, evictions 0.02%, cost/unit_token +4% for canary. All good for now.

tess: Ramping to 3 slices at 22:25 — will post status.

leo: Rerun smoke after ramp.

deploy-bot: Ramp step completed: 3 slices active at 2026-03-17T22:28:03-07:00 (traffic 10%).

tess: Post-ramp smoke: 50/50 gens ok, P99 360ms. Minor throttle counts observed but within thresholds.

raj: Monitoring steady. Keeping open runbook for 30m. No rollback.

sam: Great — leave this thread open until we hit steady-state (1h). If anything changes ping here. :thumbsup:
